statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Afternoon Nasdaq weakness has re-extended after an earlier retracement while yields and oil remain elevated.
recommendation: The mapped policy state is BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; Tail is only modestly above threshold because renewed downside and cross-asset pressure are present, while detailed independent NQ failed-retracement evidence remains incomplete.
headline: Renewed afternoon weakness lifts Tail modestly back above the block threshold
body: After an earlier midday retracement, later market reporting again showed the Nasdaq near 0.9% lower, with the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.71% and oil elevated. Fresh Finviz context showed six of eight tracked megacaps lower but mixed semiconductors. The renewed downside plus rates and oil alignment raises Tail above 25%, while incomplete bar-level NQ retracement evidence limits escalation.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low after the FOMC minutes, rose to WATCH around Thursday's U.S. data and cash open, briefly reached 26% as downside persisted, then fell to 24% on a midday retracement. The latest hour shows renewed afternoon weakness.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is modestly above the block threshold after renewed afternoon weakness. Risk is concentrated through power hour and the cash close, then is modeled to decay if retracements broaden. Friday's state-employment release is a smaller conditional WATCH checkpoint.
